svg.text: 12 October 2026 · Results: green = bounded improvement · amber = mixed · rose = negative · blue = evidence · purple = review · Dashed = review or unrun

Opportunity: I need the robot to see and use the correct brick orientation

g.title: Solution: Resolution-preserving views and temporal context
Audit: Numeral visibility audit R01e · #10959 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 12 saved input packets checked. One blue fragment shrinks from 8×4 to 2×1 px after resizing. That is a fragment, not the whole image or proof of recognition failure.

a.text: That is a fragment, not the

g.title: Audit: Actual image and history audit R01c · #10955 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: Two current camera images: 512 → 224 px. Six earlier frames are supplied as pooled features. No object crop at release. Receiving history does not prove the model uses it.
Experiment: Visibility remediation VIS01 · #10993 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 108 visibility predictions: enlarging the held numeral increased feature sensitivity, but wrist error remained about 80 degrees and opening stayed at waypoint 11. Crop-only fix rejected; semantic numeral recognition remains unresolved.
Solution: Visual-goal and language conditioning
Experiment: Numeral + coherent-goal probes R01b · #10954 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 87 offline queries on three states from one episode. Initial numeral rotation changes wrist targets by 26–34°. Held-state target stays about 94°; cue recognition versus action use remains unresolved.
Experiment: Simple-action prompt probes R02 · #10960 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 36 fixed-state/noise predictions. Wording changes actions, but “move +X/−X”, approach and extend do not reliably produce the requested primitive.
Experiment: Vanilla / V3 / V4 prompt controls R02b · #10961 RUN / COMPLETE
Result: 180 predictions across vanilla, V3 and V4. Each model: 0/18 paired direction reversals and 0/6 open/close reversals. Native input contracts differ.
Experiment: Perception vs action mapping R01f · #11011 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: 108 visibility predictions: enlarging the held numeral increased feature sensitivity, but wrist error remained about 80 degrees and opening stayed at waypoint 11. Crop-only fix rejected; semantic numeral recognition remains unresolved.
Experiment: Language / action grounding repair VIS02 · #10994 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Matched goal-diversity test completed: same broad-Pt 12 k initializer, +3,000 joint updates, 12,000 samples and 2,000/source in each arm. Six fixed-goal trajectories versus 12 varied-goal trajectories. Novel start/goal strict success: fixed 0/12, varied 10/12; original source 7/12 versus 10/12; loading 0/12 both. Six already-seen source families, one fit seed; not independent new demonstrations. A further 18 fixed-image queries per arm found at most 1.381 mm/fixed and 0.977 mm/varied endpoint response to a 270 mm text-only goal change. Proceed with visually
Solution: Visual completion checks and goal references
Experiment: Simple visual completion test LIVE02 · #11005 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Completion qualification finished with negative result. Frozen classical checks fail 80%recall gates on the 168-image two-panel study; reference conjunction reduces false positives but misses valid poses. A separate static DecisionsAPI panel, not the user's live-ranking role, gives 2/22 true-positive recall excluding identical references and 0 false completions. No completion authority granted.
Experiment: Qwen + finished-reference image LIVE03 · #11006 RUN / COMPLETE

Result: Historical Qwen 3-VL-2 B-Instruct service audited: a 180 degree false-positive completion was vetoed by independent RGB reference; old 3 candidateTTC ranked a smoothness heuristic, not learned value. Current live ranking uses DecisionsAPI under LIVE 04. Qwen weights are archived on Mint, no newly qualified Qwen control authority.
